verdict.rationale: Zamzar's docs describe an official Java SDK (Java 8+) with 'convenient access to all features of the API', so a vendor client library exists for one mainstream language. The other languages are covered only by 'fully tested code samples', which are not client libraries. Missing for 10: official SDKs for other mainstream languages (e.g. Python, Node, PHP, .NET), evidence of versioning/release cadence and active vendor maintenance, independent corroboration.
